mechanism: A self-improvement loop where after completing a {{task}} attempt, the agent generates linguistic self-critique analyzing what went wrong with the {{plan}} regarding the {{goal}}, then uses this reflection as context for a retry. Unlike fine-tuning, the model is frozen—improvement comes from explicit textual feedback stored in an episodic memory buffer. It writes self-critique to a {{scratchpad}} memory buffer, using this feedback to improve the next attempt.
failure_modes: Shallow Reflection: {{critique}} is generic ('try harder') without actionable insight.
Reflection Drift: Each retry diverges further from the goal.
Premature Success: Declaring success before the task is actually solved.
